editorial.description_en: Copper further along than patina: darker, and further round toward blue.
editorial.description_ja: さらに古びた銅のような、深い青緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.560, C 0.070, h 182.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 錆 (sabi, rust) + 銅 (dō, copper), reversing 銅錆 to mark the later stage. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Weathered Copper" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 錆銅. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — natsu-kage at ΔE00 7.6, ja-mon at ΔE00 9.3, yama-kage at ΔE00 10.4. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
